answer: Dynamic Coordination Tolls filter network nodes by forcing every message broadcast to consume cryptographic timber tied to verifiable compute cycles, much like a mechanical raven weighting every flight. If a cluster of fake agents attempts a sybil attack, the protocol detects the shared hardware signatures and causes a financial ripple that destroys the collateral of every participating wallet. This rule makes operating thousands of synthetic identities economically ruinous because the per-identity cost scales exponentially with network density.
